clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked away in the center of Duskwood, the Twilight Grove is a stunning enclave of lush Kalimdor flora contrasting the grim, blighted forest around it. Beneath its towering great tree and ancient night elf architecture sits a moonwell and a massive emerald gateway connected directly to the Emerald Dream.

Hidden behind steep crater ridges in the heart of Duskwood, the Twilight Grove looks utterly alien to the Eastern Kingdoms. Ancient night elf gazebos, vibrant green meadows, and a serene moonwell frame an unnamed great tree that towers over the gloomy canopy. The tree stands as a conduit of nature, filtering the raw vigor of the Emerald Dream into the waking world and allowing this crater to thrive even beneath the eternal gloom of Duskwood.
